name: asia-pacific-news-digest
description: Asia-Pacific news digest across East Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania with comprehensive sources

steps.name: fetch-east-asia
steps.prompt:
Fetch East Asian news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇯🇵 Japan Sources:
- Japan Times: https://www.japantimes.co.jp/feed/ (English)
- NHK World: https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/ (check RSS)
- Asahi Shimbun Asia & Japan Watch: https://www.asahi.com/ajw/ (check)
- Mainichi Japan: https://mainichi.jp/english/rss (check)

🇨🇳 China Sources:
- CGTN: https://www.cgtn.com/subscribe/rss.xml (English, state media)
- China Daily: http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/rss/world_news.xml (English)
- South China Morning Post (SCMP): https://www.scmp.com/rss/2/feed (English, Hong Kong)
- Global Times: https://www.globaltimes.cn/rss.xml (English, nationalist)

🇰🇷 South Korea:
- Korea Herald: http://www.koreaherald.com/rss/020000000000.xml (English)
- Korea Times: http://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/rss/rss.xml (check)
- KBS World (check)

🇹🇼 Taiwan:
- Taipei Times: https://www.taipeitimes.com/rss/ (English)
- Taiwan News: https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/rss (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract top 5 stories per source with headline and summary.

Return structured list noting English-language sources.

steps.name: format-asia-pacific-digest
steps.prompt:
Create an Asia-Pacific News Digest for Discord.

EAST ASIA:
{{east_asia}}

SOUTH ASIA:
{{south_asia}}

SOUTHEAST ASIA:
{{southeast_asia}}

OCEANIA:
{{oceania}}

FORMAT:
```
🌏 **Asia-Pacific News Digest — {date}**

**🇯🇵 Japan, 🇨🇳 China, 🇰🇷 South Korea, 🇹🇼 Taiwan**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source + Country flag)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇮🇳 India, 🇵🇰 Pakistan, South Asia**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇸🇬 Singapore, 🇹🇭 Thailand, 🇮🇩 Indonesia, Southeast Asia**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇦🇺 Australia & 🇳🇿 New Zealand**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**📊 Asia-Pacific Brief**
Regional themes:
• [Theme: economic/security/diplomatic]
• [Cross-regional story]

_Covering 15+ Asia-Pacific nations — OpenFang Asia-Pacific_
```

Focus on regionally significant stories. Keep under 2000 characters. Include country flags (🇯🇵🇨🇳🇰🇷🇹🇼🇮🇳🇵🇰🇧🇩🇱🇰🇳🇵🇸🇬🇹🇭🇮🇩🇵🇭🇻🇳🇲🇾🇲🇲🇰🇭🇱🇦🇦🇺🇳🇿).
